summary: The patch adds authenticated normal and emergency signing-key replacement, bounds retired-key publication by the maximum access-token lifetime, keeps JWKS and Passport verification aligned with live keys, records audit metadata, and adds the required rotation, cache-refresh, and emergency tests. No actionable defects were found.

evidence: src/passport.ts lines 1459-1517 require an administrator browser session, exact origin and CSRF token, and record the actor, origin, request id and key ids.

src/auth_store.ts lines 1494-1559 atomically replaces the active key, writes the audit record, and either retains the old public key for the bounded overlap or deletes all retired keys for emergency retirement.
src/token_service.ts lines 129-170 and 185-275 publish active plus live retired keys, retry signing if the current key changes, and verify retired-key tokens only while their overlap is live.
README.md lines 100-115 documents normal rotation, verifier cache refresh and emergency retirement; tests/passport_cutover_test.ts lines 122-210 covers those workflows.
